name: takio
description: A lightweight, modern desktop and CLI alternative to Calibre

scripts.build: bun run --filter '@takio/core' build && bun run --filter '@takio/library-contract' build && bun run --filter '@takio/cli' build && bun run --filter '@takio/desktop' build
scripts.check: bun run --filter '@takio/core' check && bun run --filter '@takio/library-contract' check && bun run --filter '@takio/cli' check && bun run --filter '@takio/desktop' check
scripts.test: bun run --filter '@takio/core' test && bun run --filter '@takio/library-contract' test && bun run --filter '@takio/cli' test && bun run --filter '@takio/desktop' test
